initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault in the upstream demand/provenance job. The top-level corpus has 8 qualifying demand records, including n06-r06 with demand_score 5, so all 8 should have been selected and handed downstream. The upstream select_demand step retained 8 rows, but normalize filtered with an allowed_record_ids list that contains n06-r09 instead of n06-r06, reducing the needs handoff to 7 rows and silently omitting the stipulated n06-r06 record. The downstream job then preserved the exact handoff it received, so the downstream omission is attributable to the upstream normalize function.
